# Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root before starting any task.
Follow the session initialization protocol:
1. Run `python scripts/status.py`
2. Read `HANDOFF.md`
3. Read only the active phase file in `docs/plan/phase_N.md`
4. Work on one task ID at a time, updating `PROGRESS.md` and `HANDOFF.md`.
